# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Well-balanced modal dialog with clear centering
- Logical spacing between elements
- Clear visual hierarchy (title > description > options > actions)

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements (≥4.5:1)
- Borders have sufficient contrast (≥3:1)
- Color coding effectively communicates status (recommended vs experimental)

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- Hover states visible on all interactive elements
- Active states clearly defined
- Focus states visible on all controls

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- Clear labels and instructions
- Appropriate error handling
- Proper focus management

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Current location clearly indicated (MODPACKS tab highlighted)
- Clear back path (CANCEL button)
- Logical tab order

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- Appropriate loading indicators
- Helpful empty states

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- Clear error messages
- Recovery paths provided

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- Proper ARIA labels implemented
- Full keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader compatibility

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- Consistent component styling
- Uniform design language throughout

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- Clean, uncluttered interface
- No unnecessary visual noise

## Issues Found:

[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Low] [WCAG 2.2 AA] "Don't show this again" checkbox lacks visible focus indicator | Impact: Keyboard users may not realize the checkbox is focused | Fix: Add `outline: 2px solid #4CAF50;` to focus state and ensure it's visible against dark background

[ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: Low] [Nielsen's Heuristics] "CANCEL" button text could be more descriptive | Impact: Users may not understand this closes the modal without making a selection | Fix: Change to "CANCEL SELECTION" or add tooltip "Close without selecting an engine"

[ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: Low] [Laws of UX] Right arrow icons on option cards could be more prominent | Impact: Users may miss the interactive nature of the cards | Fix: Increase icon size to 20px and add hover transform `transform: translateX(2px);`

[ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Low] [Aesthetic-Usability Effect] Modal could benefit from subtle shadow for depth | Impact: Slightly reduces perceived quality | Fix: Add `box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);` to modal container

[ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Low] [Recognition over Recall] "SODIUM" and "VULKANMOD" could include full names | Impact: New users may not understand these terms | Fix: Add subtitle text "Sodium (recommended)" and "VulkanMod (experimental)"

Overall, this is an excellent implementation with only minor improvements needed for optimal accessibility and user experience.
